row.evidence: Vectra's docs cover SAML 2.0 SSO with any IdP, with users 'assigned the Vectra role defined for their user or group in the IdP', and a REST /users API; no SCIM endpoint is documented anywhere in the docs index or API guide.
row.notes: New row. Quote-only NDR/XDR platform (demo and 45-day trial; no public pricing). No SCIM: Respond UX accounts are created just in time on SAML sign-in, with the role taken from a SAML 'role' claim, or as local users through the v3.4 REST API (GET/POST /users, GET/PATCH/DELETE /users/<id>, OAuth2 client credentials, 4 req/s steady, 10 burst). DELETE deactivates local and SAML profiles, but a SAML user is reactivated by signing in again, so offboarding depends on the IdP. Audit log API (/events/audits) available. Okta and Entra use custom SAML apps; no catalogue listing.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint in the Vectra docs index (llms.txt, 0 matches for SCIM) or the v3.4 API guide. Users arrive via SAML sign-in (role from a SAML 'role' claim) or the REST /users API.

auth.notes: OAuth2 client credentials from an API Client created by a Super Admin under Manage > API Clients; the client is assigned a role (Read-Only, Restricted Admin, Security Analyst, Settings Admin, Auditor).

capabilities.notes: POST creates local (non-SAML) users only; PATCH cannot change the role of SAML-only users; DELETE deactivates local and SAML profiles. '/groups' in this API are host/account detection groups, not user groups.

endpoints.purpose: List users (filters: email, role, last_login_gte; page_size up to 5000)
Create a local (non-SAML) user with name, role, email
Delete user (deactivates local and SAML profiles)

rate_limits.text: Per tenant across all v3.4 endpoints: steady-state 4 requests per second, burst 10 requests per second; 429 when exceeded.

limitations.text: The users endpoint cannot create local profiles for emails that already signed in through SAML, and cannot change roles for SAML-only users.

user_api.notes: Documented in the v3.4 API guide (PDF, August 2026) for Respond UX (RUX). Quadrant UX (QUX) deployments use the v2.x API instead.

okta.notes: OIN search 'vectra' returns no results; Vectra's Okta guide has customers build a custom SAML app (Create App Integration).

entra.notes: Vectra's Entra guide uses 'Create your own application' (not a gallery app); no Vectra entry in the Entra tutorial index.

fallbacks.other_sync: QUX (Quadrant UX) also supports LDAP/Active Directory, RADIUS and TACACS+ external authentication
fallbacks.notes: SAML users get their role from the IdP's 'role' claim at sign-in; a deleted SAML user is reactivated by logging in again via the IdP, i.e. accounts are created/restored just in time.
